plugin.name: Editorial Masthead Profiles
plugin.summary: Adds public profile pages for members of an OJS editorial masthead.
plugin.description: Adds public profile pages for current editorial masthead members and links member names from the standard OJS Editorial Masthead page. Profiles use journal-scoped OJS user and masthead data and support localized interface strings.

release.description: Initial Plugin Gallery release. Adds standalone editorial masthead profile pages and links for OJS 3.5.
